title: PRICING BY GROUP SIZE
sub: Same pricing for the official session, the custom camp and groups/clubs. The more of you there are, the lower the price per person. No discretionary discounts.
solo_note: Also applies to solo bookings (1 adult)

duo.label: Solo / Duo
duo.pitch: Price for the custom camp solo or as an adult pair, or for the official session for a single adult.

trio.label: Trio to 5
trio.pitch: Price for the custom camp as a team (3 or 4 friends) or for groups/clubs of 5 athletes.

club.label: Club / Group
club.pitch: Price for organised clubs or groups of 6 to 10 adult athletes.

private.label: Private gym
private.pitch: Full privatisation of a session for an entire club. Custom quote.

family.title: PARENT + CHILD PACKAGE
family.intro: You travel with your child aged 8-17. The package covers 1 parent + 1 child. Each additional child is billed at the extra-child rate. If your partner also takes part, both parents move to the Solo/Duo rate ({duoPrice} per person and per week) and each child is added at {extraChild} per week.
family.base_sub: Fixed package by duration. The first child is included.
family.extra_sub: Rate per additional child, or per child if both parents take part.
family.example: Example: 1 parent + 2 children for 1 week = {ex1base} + {ex1child} = {ex1total}. 2 parents + 1 child for 2 weeks = 2 × {ex2adult} + {ex2child} = {ex2total}.

included.flight: Domestic flight Istanbul to Makhachkala (Wrestling) or Grozny (MMA)

not_included: Not included: international flight to Istanbul (arranged by the applicant), travel insurance (mandatory), personal equipment, personal expenses. MKR surcharge for applications less than 30 days before departure (express processing).
